primary: single aliquot per TCGA sample15; finite fraction in [0,1]; exact cancer and sample key; no OS eligibility filter
sensitivity: median of valid aliquots within sample15; no cancer conflicts; no clipping invalid fractions
resolution: TCGA expression sample IDs are 15 chars; this is sample-level cross-assay matching, not verified same vial/portion
statistic: within-cancer Spearman, at least 30 unique patients and variable scores/fractions
multiplicity: BH over all assessed cancer x 15 CM x 2 branches x 2 aliquot policies; retain raw p
limitations: exploratory composition associations; no purity adjustment yet; no external validation; RNA scores may reflect immune-cell abundance; not a predictive biomarker
